title: HABIT Foundation Incubation Centre Hosts HABIT INNOVATE 2026 Student Prototype Showcase in Mumbai
summary: HABIT Foundation Incubation Centre's HABIT INNOVATE 2026 showcase in Mumbai saw students present prototypes addressing real-world challenges, guided by industry mentors.
body_html:
Mumbai, 4 November 2026: The HABIT Foundation Incubation Centre, an initiative that fosters innovation, creativity and entrepreneurial thinking among students, organised HABIT INNOVATE 2026 – Innovation & Prototype Showcase. Held under the theme ‘Innovating for Real-World Impact’ with the tagline ‘Ideas That Inspire – Solutions That Transform’, the event gave students a platform to turn their ideas into practical solutions for real-world challenges.

The student prototype showcase featured concepts across child safety, healthcare, education, sustainability, energy and technology, with participants encouraged to identify everyday challenges, develop prototypes and explore entrepreneurial opportunities.

The sessions brought together industry experts and startup mentors. Chief Guest Mr. Umesh Rathod, Award-Winning Startup Mentor, stressed the importance of networking, adaptability and persistence in entrepreneurship. Mr. Jawahar Nidamboor, Assistant Vice President – Medical and Clinical Affairs, Alpha MD, spoke on identifying genuine customer problems and validating ideas through prototyping. Mr. Pankaj Bafna, Founder and Managing Director, Xia Healthcare, discussed building commercially viable solutions through customer understanding and a strong value proposition. Jury members Mr. Nilesh Maurya and Ms. Sumi Ajmera urged students to embrace continuous learning and stay open to new perspectives.

Mr. Vijay Talreja, Director, HABIT Foundation and Trustee, VES, said, “At HABIT, we believe every student has the potential to become an innovator. Our focus is to create an environment where young minds are encouraged to think independently, identify challenges and develop solutions through experimentation and practical learning. We want students to move beyond simply having ideas and gain the confidence, skills and guidance to turn those ideas into reality. HABIT INNOVATE is a step towards building this culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among students.”

Dr. Jyoti Chandwani, Nodal Officer, HABIT Foundation Incubation Centre, said, “Through HABIT, we aim to provide students with the right guidance, mentorship and platform to explore ideas, experiment and develop practical solutions to real-world challenges. Our focus is to nurture creativity, build problem-solving skills and encourage an entrepreneurial mindset, empowering students to turn their ideas into meaningful innovations.”

The event was convened under the guidance of Dr. Jyoti Chandwani and coordinated by Ms. Pooja Jayawant, Manager – HABIT Incubation & Event Coordinator, with support from the HABIT Foundation team, institutional representatives, faculty members and student volunteers.

Through such initiatives, HABIT Foundation seeks to build a problem-solving mindset among young learners, encouraging them to think beyond textbooks and experiment with ideas. By giving students access to industry experts, mentors and an incubation ecosystem, it aims to bridge the gap between classroom learning and practical innovation, while introducing them to the fundamentals of entrepreneurship and product development.
